api.error.caption_required.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~50 chars. TONE: instructive. VARIABLES: none. Shown when caption field is empty.

api.error.config_load_failed.description: LOCATION: Publish settings panel, below form fields. LIMIT: ~50 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when pipeline list cannot be fetched.

api.error.http_error.defaultMessage: Request failed (status {statusCode}). Try again or contact support.
api.error.http_error.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~80 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: statusCode (HTTP status number, not translated).

api.error.invalid_response.defaultMessage: Received an unexpected response from Intellix.
api.error.invalid_response.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~60 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when API response body is not valid JSON.

api.error.invalid_settings.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~40 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when publishRef JSON cannot be parsed.

api.error.network_error.defaultMessage: Could not reach Intellix. Check the URL and your connection.
api.error.network_error.description: LOCATION: Settings panel / publish error. LIMIT: ~70 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when fetch fails or times out.

api.error.pipeline_not_configured.defaultMessage: No brand or pipeline is configured in Intellix. Contact your administrator.
api.error.pipeline_not_configured.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~90 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when Odoo has no CRM team/pipeline.

api.error.publish_failed.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~50 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Generic fallback when publish fails without a specific code.

api.error.server_error.defaultMessage: Intellix encountered an error. Try again in a few minutes.
api.error.server_error.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~70 chars. TONE: reassuring. VARIABLES: none. Shown on HTTP 500 from Odoo.

api.error.unauthorized.defaultMessage: Invalid API key. Check your Intellix settings and try again.
api.error.unauthorized.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~80 chars. TONE: neutral/helpful. VARIABLES: none. Shown when Odoo rejects the Canva API key (HTTP 401).

api.error.unknown_action.defaultMessage: This action is not supported. Update the app and try again.
api.error.unknown_action.description: LOCATION: Publish flow error toast. LIMIT: ~80 chars. TONE: neutral. VARIABLES: none. Shown when the MCP action name is invalid (HTTP 400).
